testcase.name: Scenario: Cancel an uncommitted custom panel edit: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:40:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel an uncommitted custom panel edit ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the ribbon customization dialog has a staged "2D Sketches" addition to the initially empty "Part | 3D Model" custom panel ✔ When the user clicks "Cancel" ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And no custom panel appears in the visible ribbon ✔ When the user reopens ribbon customization ✔ Then the "Part | 3D Model" custom panel list is empty ✔ And "2D Sketches" is available in the source list
